name: Supriya Subudhi
bio: Staff PM with ~10 years of experience spanning engineering, fintech, ad-tech, and consumer tech — with hands-on technical roots as a software and data engineer at Microsoft. Ran multi-country A/B tests at the scale of tens of millions of users, improving ecosystem health through data-driven product decisions during a critical business transition. Shipped a Gen AI feature covered by TechCrunch that directly improved women's D1 retention — a core north-star metric — by improving match quality at scale

sessions.title: A/B Testing AI Products Is Weird: What Changes When the Product Is Probabilistic
